{{Quote|Who's on Quarantine duty?''"<br />"''Perry and Quinze.|Jorad Pressor and Trilli|<ref name="SQ" />}}
'''Perry''' was an individual who served a term as one of the law-enforcing [[Peacekeeper (Outbound Flight Colony)|Peacekeepers]] of the [[Outbound Flight Colony]], the government established by those who survived the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] survey ship [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']] after its crash in a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] called [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]].<ref name="SQ" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Human]] [[Trilli]] mentioned to fellow crewman [[Jorad Pressor]] that Perry was assigned with [[Quinze]] to guard the [[Quarantine section]], where the colony kept [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children under surveillance. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Chak Fel]] was investigating the ruins of ''Outbound Flight'' when he discovered the small prison. A [[Unidentified attendant|female attendant]] watching over the children initially mistook him for Perry, but quickly realized he was someone else.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Perry was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" />
